ui.labOpenSpace: Open your personal space to save and apply
ui.labPublishSaveFirst: Save the preset first, then publish a copy.
ui.labPublishHint: Creates an autonomous public copy; the private original is untouched.
ui.labDefaultHint: Inherited by titles without their own preset. Title presets and off-toggles always win.
ui.labDefaultOk: Preset set as default in your space.
ui.labDefaultPartial: Preset saved; applying failed — retry without duplicates.
ui.labDefaultSaveFirst: Save the preset first, then set it as default.
ui.labDefaultRemoved: Default removed. The preset stays in your library.
ui.labAnonHint: Anonymous try-out: saving and applying need your personal space.
ui.labSampleData: Sample data: title, rating and rank are placeholders, not the real title.
ui.labVerifyHint: Renders the SAVED preset through the same endpoint Stremio uses. Edits after verifying mark this result as stale.
ui.labVerifyNeedSave: Save the preset first, then verify it on a real poster.
ui.labVerifyError: Poster failed to render (unknown ID or upstream error). The editor is untouched.
ui.labVerifyStale: Outdated: the editor changed after this check — verify again.
ui.presetsSubtitle: Public badges to copy into your space.
ui.labHouseHint: Start with a Pictorium style. Customize its content, text, size and colors.
ui.labFreeHint: Design freely: change text, shape, dimensions, background, border and shadow.
ui.labDiscardChanges: Replace the current work? Your unsaved changes will be lost.
ui.labDraftAvailable: You have an unfinished badge on this device.
ui.labDraftStorageError: Draft storage unavailable. Export your work before leaving.
ui.labImportValues: Preset geçersiz veya aralık dışı değerler içeriyor.
ui.labVariablesHint: These values follow the movie or series. Insert them at the cursor; edit sample data to try long or missing values.
ui.labInvalidColor: Use a HEX color, for example #ffffff.
ui.labUseForTitleHint: Choose a movie or series: the preset will be selected in Badges. Save the poster to apply it.
ui.labSampleDataHint: Preview only. Empty values simulate missing metadata; your preset keeps its dynamic variables.
ui.labApplyHint: This replaces the corresponding badge. Save the poster to keep your choice. After editing a preset, refresh its version and save the poster again.
ui.labCreatePreset: Create a preset in Badge Lab
ui.labSaveFailed: Could not save. Your changes are still here: retry or save a copy.
ui.labAutoHint: Auto fits the content. The minimum width follows the text; reduce its size or shorten it for a smaller badge.
ui.labColorAdjustmentsHint: 100 keeps the original look. Lower or raise a value to adjust the whole badge.
ui.labSettingsHintcolors: Choose background and text colors. Enable Customize to replace the original style.
ui.labSettingsHintsize: Resize the whole badge, or adjust its width, height and text separately.
ui.labSettingsHintborder: Enable Customize to change the border or shadow. Turn it off to restore the original style.
ui.labSettingsHinttype: Choose what the badge displays. Empty fields use the movie’s live information.
ui.labSettingsHintshape: Choose a shape, then adjust its corners and spacing.
ui.labSettingsHintcolorsCustom: Choose a solid or gradient background, then set its colors and transparency.
ui.labSettingsHintborderCustom: Turn the border and shadow on or off, then adjust their appearance.
ui.labSettingsHinttypeCustom: Write your text. Use the buttons below to insert the movie’s rating, year or genre automatically.
ui.labSliderResetHint: Double-click or double-tap a slider to restore its default. You can also use ↺.
ui.labRestartHint: Restore this style’s original settings. Undo brings your edits back.
ui.familyPresetsHint: One look per badge, straight from the Lab. Standard resets that badge to the poster style; everything stays staged until you press Save.
ui.familyFixedLayoutNote: Rank and Genre presets style the Standard layout only — Fresh and Card keep their fixed numerals. Extra presets still render at the top.
ui.familyStandardHint: Reset this badge to the poster style (staged until Save)
ui.familySavedHint: Drop the staged change and follow the saved look again
ui.familyHandoffError: Could not stage this preset for the title.
ui.familyHandoffStaged: Preset staged for this title — press Save to keep it.
ui.familyFollowSettingsHint: Delete the saved choice: this badge follows the space defaults again (staged until Save)
ui.familyNativeHint: No global override: render the native poster style
ui.familyFollowPortraitHint: Inherit the portrait default for the landscape shape
ui.familyNoCompatible: No compatible presets in your library yet.
ui.familyUseAsDefaultHint: Apply this preset to all posters of this space, current format only
ui.familyUseAsDefaultError: Could not update the global default.
ui.familyDropResolveError: Could not verify the previous badge style: the follow choice was not saved.
ui.familyTechHint: Native style: only the controls below apply — everything else stays live from the poster.
ui.familyTechNoPreview: This artwork renders on the server: save the preset, then check its thumbnail in My presets below.
ui.familyTechNoTextColor: Knockout letters are cut out of the plate, so text color does not apply.
ui.familyTechDraftPreview: Live server preview of the unsaved draft (deterministic fixtures, nothing saved yet).
ui.labPositionHint: Moves the rendered badge on the poster (frame offset, ±2000px). Zero = native anchor. Additive with the title tuning offset; glyphs inside the badge never move.
ui.labSettingsHintposition: Move the badge on the poster without touching the design: additive with the per-title offsets.
